caption: The drawing depicts a rectangular wooden chest with a flat lid viewed from an angle that shows the front and right side. The chest is colored in shades of brown, resembling wood grain, and sits against a plain light-colored background. The front and side panels of the chest feature decorative motifs, including fan-shaped elements above stylized tulip-like flowers in beige, pink, and black. There is a centrally placed diamond-shaped design on the front panel, decorated with concentric oval and line patterns in red, white, and black. The chest’s edges and base are reinforced with darker brown bands. Visible dovetail joints are present at the chest's corners. The overall composition is focused on the chest, with no other objects or elements in the image. The artist's signature, "J. Weyrich," appears in small green text in the bottom right corner.
title: Pa. German Chest
